component-o.description-s: 2.5-5.5 V input, 1 A, 1.5 MHz synchronous step-down converter, adjustable output 0.6 V to VIN, SOT-23-5

cfgpins-ao.1c: EN high (VIH 1.2 V max) enables, do not leave floating: tied to VIN

cfgpins-ao.5c: VFB 0.6 V; VOUT = 0.6 V x (1 + R1/R2): 200k / 200k gives the row's 1.2 V (TI typical application R1, R2 0603 1 %; C3 feed-forward optional)

specs-o.en_note-s: no internal pull: the EN input must be terminated and not left floating

en_source-o.table-s: Electrical Characteristics: VIL low-level threshold at EN 0.4 V min, VIH high-level threshold at EN 1.2 V max (2.5 V <= VIN <= 5.5 V)

specs-o.replaces_s: NCP1529ASNT1G (obsolete): same SOT-23-5 pin order EN/GND/SW/VIN/FB and VFB 0.6 V

vref_source-o.table-s: 6.5 Electrical Characteristics, OUTPUT: VFB feedback regulation voltage 0.588 / 0.6 / 0.612 V

cout_source-o.table-s: 8.2.2.5 Input and Output Capacitor Selection: 'designed to operate with an output capacitor of 10 uF to 47 uF, as outlined in Table 4' (Table 4 p10: 2.2 uH with 10 uF standard; 22 uF and 2x22 uF also checked; effective C may vary +20 %/-50 %)

iout_source-o.table-s: 6.3 Recommended Operating Conditions: IOUT output current max 1 A

specs-o.loop_note-s: internally compensated; a feed-forward capacitor C3 from VOUT to FB (across R1, Figure 5 p9) 'improves the loop bandwidth'; 8.2.2.2 (p10) recommends 6.8 pF for R2 = 100 k; no bandwidth figure

load_regulation_source-o.table-s: Figure 10. Load Regulation (curve points via pdf-graph)
load_regulation_source-o.derived: CCM portion 0.5 -> 1.0 A: VOUT 1.8 V -0.0002 % -> -0.2537 % = 4.56 mV / 0.497 A = 9.18 mV/A; VOUT 3.3 V 0.0 % -> -0.0975 % = 3.22 mV / 0.497 A = 6.47 mV/A. Below ~0.4 A the curve is the PFM offset, not a resistance. NOT under load_regulation_mv_per_a: the record's VOUT is 1.2 V and no curve is drawn at 1.2 V

load_transient-ao.conditions_source-s: Application Curves header p12: VIN = 5 V, VOUT = 1.8 V, L = 2.2 uH, TA = 25 C unless otherwise noted; circuit Figure 5 (p9)
